finding_closures.evidence: The original exact probe on e916704 proves both public HTTP no-signal FAIL/missing requests become ABSTAIN and proposals reject. Synthetic historical immutable DECIDED+FAIL remains readable, but public adoption returns 422 with active decisions unchanged.
finding_closures.implementation: decisionHardFailures always runs before decision publication and also runs in validateDecisions for new and historical adoption. The immutable receipt is not rewritten.
finding_closures.scope_limit: The fixed requests stop at rejected proposals, so the two old conditional apply branches are no longer executed. That explains the count reduction from 94 to 92, not deleted assertions.

regression_evidence.reason: Transient loopback transport failures occurred before handler arrival in different full batches. They correctly produced safe ABSTAIN but did not exercise intended scenarios. All raw failed batches remain. A dedicated client, longer positive deadlines and consumed request body made focused proof possible; substantive assertions were retained.
regression_evidence.timeout_diagnostic: Focused FaultPersistence passed all 21 assertions including a handler-entered timeout with context deadline exceeded, 503, redirect, oversize and continued work.
regression_evidence.harness_changes: See probe-harness.diff: positive deadline 1s -> 5s; explicit failure timeout 20ms -> 3s with handler fallback 10s; per-server client; consume request body; diagnostic transport error logging. No product source edits.

open_adapter_issue.finding: The frozen adapter incorrectly requires confidence to equal the selected option probability. Official docs explicitly permit distinct values. Consequently a probability-mismatch ABSTAIN assertion in the old fixture is not valid acceptance evidence and is excluded from contract approval.

official_sources_independently_read.support: Choice is the highest-probability option; example selected probability 0.88 and confidence 0.81.
Confidence summarizes the shape of the distribution and is not simply the selected probability.

open_adapter_issue.requested_delta_validation: Accept distinct in-range confidence/probability when chosen option is argmax and confidence passes frozen threshold. Reject unknown/nonmax chosen action, malformed distribution, low confidence and changed scope/model. Recompute existing development raw separately; no repeat live calls.
